title: After the Debut: Our First Goal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unintimidated by the pressure of the Twinkle Series, Matikanetannhauser finishes her debut race with a big smile and declares that she had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing Matikanetannhauser's brilliant run, the spectators begin wondering how she sizes up against Mihono Bourbon, who just recently made a big splash at her own debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After returning to campus, we make winning the Classic Triple Crown our goal for her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first goal is to come in fifth place or higher in a G1 race!
